import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int r, c, dis;
        Node(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n, n1, m, lim;
    static int[][] a = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] b = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] d0 = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[205][205];
    static boolean[][] ok = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] okb = new boolean[12][12];
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> graph;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        Edge fwd = new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), c);
        Edge rev = new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size(), 0);
        graph.get(u).add(fwd);
        graph.get(v).add(rev);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = sc.nextInt();
        lim = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < 205; i++) Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(b[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(d0[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ok[i], false);
            Arrays.fill(okb[i], false);
        }

        Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
        n = 0;
        n1 = 0;

        // Read first grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(he);
                } else if (ch != 'Y') {
                    ok[i][j] = true;
                    d0[i][j] = lim;
                    int k = ch - '0';
                    if (k > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++n;
                        capacity[0][n] = k;
                        n1 += k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Copy ok to okb
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(ok[i], 0, okb[i], 0, 12);
        }

        // Read second grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') continue;
                int k = ch - '0';
                if (k > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++n;
                    capacity[n][m * m + 1] = k;
                }
            }
        }

        // Adjust if n != m*m
        if (n != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int k = b[i][j];
                        capacity[k][n + 1] = capacity[k][m * m + 1];
                        capacity[k][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int sink = n + 1;

        // BFS from Z to compute d0
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node he = q.poll();
            int i = he.r, j = he.c;
            d0[i][j] = he.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ni = i + dx[k];
                int nj = j + dy[k];
                if (ni >= 1 && ni <= m && nj >= 1 && nj <= m && ok[ni][nj]) {
                    Node e = new Node(ni, nj, he.dis + 1);
                    q.add(e);
                    ok[ni][nj] = false;
                }
            }
        }

        // For each a cell, BFS to set capacities
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                // Reset ok to okb
                for (int x = 0; x < 12; x++) {
                    System.arraycopy(okb[x], 0, ok[x], 0, 12);
                }
                ok[i][j] = false;
                Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                q.add(he);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    Node cur = q.poll();
                    int x = cur.r, y = cur.c;
                    if (b[x][y] > 0 && cur.dis <= d0[x][y]) {
                        capacity[a[i][j]][b[x][y]] = n1;
                    }
                    if (cur.dis + 1 > lim || cur.dis >= d0[x][y]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[k];
                        int ny = y + dy[k];
                        if (nx >= 1 && nx <= m && ny >= 1 && ny <= m && ok[nx][ny]) {
                            Node e = new Node(nx, ny, cur.dis + 1);
                            q.add(e);
                            ok[nx][ny] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        graph = new ArrayList<>(n + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int u = 0; u <= n + 1; u++) {
            for (int v = 0; v <= n + 1; v++) {
                if (capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                    addEdge(u, v, capacity[u][v]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Max flow (Edmonds-Karp)
        int maxflow = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] parent = new int[n + 2];
            int[] pedge = new int[n + 2];
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Arrays.fill(pedge, -1);
            Queue<Integer> qq = new LinkedList<>();
            parent[0] = 0;
            qq.add(0);
            while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                int u = qq.poll();
                if (u == sink) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && parent[e.to] == -1) {
                        parent[e.to] = u;
                        pedge[e.to] = i;
                        qq.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == -1) break;
            int add = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = sink; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
                add = Math.min(add, graph.get(parent[v]).get(pedge[v]).cap);
            }
            for (int v = sink; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
                Edge e = graph.get(parent[v]).get(pedge[v]);
                e.cap -= add;
                graph.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += add;
            }
            maxflow += add;
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
